name: Musashi
title: Victorious Duelist
summary: Dual-wielding samurai who specializes in getting enemies to lower their guard in duels.
lore: An impossibly skilled and eager swordsman in his youth, Musashi eventually found his taste for violence fading. He retreated to the practice of art, and to penning tomes of technique and philosophy. Now that he finds himself in a world of chaos and conflict, he wanders Izumo, taking in its beauty and hoping to put off his return to violence.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If the attack is not a Strong Hit, place [Vanish] on this hero for 1 turn.
The third hit will also ignore [Shield], [Barrier], [Ward], and [Immortal].

skills.name: Agitating Blow
skills.description:
Attack 1 enemy 440%ATK with a 50% chance to place [DEF Down II] on the target for 2 turns.

If the target’s ATK is lower than this hero’s ATK, repeat the attack against a random enemy.
